paragraphs.text: Almost by accident, you discover a channel between two rocks that leads into the cliff face. The daylight is just enough to pick out a recessed chamber, and the man crouched there in silence, glaring at you.
“Damn you,” he snarls. “Haven’t I been tormented enough?” However, he seems a little calmer.
To enter his refuge, turn to 191. If you don’t wish to risk it, turn to 160.
